# ENCE & MICE - R Parallel vs C, Year Scaling Plots

## Setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
cutoff <- 0.50  # must match the cutoff used to generate all four .rds files below
tag    <- sprintf("cutoff%02d", round(cutoff * 100))

ence_sync_file <- sprintf("section_4_2_6_ENCE_sync_year_scaling_%s.rds", tag)
ence_C_file    <- sprintf("section_4_2_6_ENCE_C_year_scaling_%s.rds",    tag)
mice_sync_file <- sprintf("section_4_2_6_MICE_sync_year_scaling_%s.rds", tag)
mice_C_file    <- sprintf("section_4_2_6_MICE_C_year_scaling_%s.rds",    tag)

ence_sync <- readRDS(ence_sync_file)
ence_C    <- readRDS(ence_C_file)
mice_sync <- readRDS(mice_sync_file)
mice_C    <- readRDS(mice_C_file)
```

## Helper Functions

```{r helper_functions, message=FALSE}
report_metrics <- function(true, pred, method_name, elapsed) {
  rmse <- sqrt(mean((pred - true)^2))
  cat(method_name, "\n", sep = "")
  cat("Time:  ", round(elapsed, 2), "seconds\n")
  cat("RMSE:  ", rmse, "\n")
  cat("Bias %:", sum(pred - true) / sum(true) * 100, "\n")
  cat("R2:    ", 1 - sum((pred - true)^2) / sum((true - mean(true))^2), "\n")
  cat("SRMSE: ", rmse / mean(true), "\n\n")
}

print_meta <- function(name, meta) {
  cat(name, "\n")
  cat("  description:", meta$description, "\n")
  cat("  cutoff:", meta$cutoff, " n_reps:", meta$n_reps,
      " n_stations:", meta$n_stations, "\n")
  if (!is.null(meta$m)) cat("  m:", meta$m, "\n")
  cat("  year_values:", paste(meta$year_values, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("  years_full: ", paste(range(meta$years_full), collapse = "-"), "\n")
  cat("  run_time:   ", format(meta$run_time), "\n")
  cat("  hostname:   ", meta$hostname, " job:", meta$slurm_job_id,
      " nodelist:", meta$slurm_nodelist, "\n")
  cat("  R version:  ", meta$r_version, "\n\n")
}

# Builds and prints the year-scaling table for one method (ENCE or MICE):
# timing mean +/- sd per year count, paired per-rep speedup, and RMSE.
# Speedup is paired per-rep (not mean(sync)/mean(C)) because both the sync and
# C runs used the same seed (2000 + r) per rep, so rep r in each drew the same
# sampled years and the same masked cells - a fair like-for-like comparison.
print_scaling_table <- function(method_name, year_values,
                                 sync_time_mat, C_time_mat,
                                 sync_true, sync_pred, sync_years,
                                 C_true, C_pred, C_years) {

  sync_time_mean <- rowMeans(sync_time_mat)
  sync_time_sd   <- apply(sync_time_mat, 1, sd)
  C_time_mean    <- rowMeans(C_time_mat)
  C_time_sd      <- apply(C_time_mat, 1, sd)

  speedup_mat  <- sync_time_mat / C_time_mat
  speedup_mean <- rowMeans(speedup_mat)
  speedup_sd   <- apply(speedup_mat, 1, sd)

  sync_rmse <- sapply(year_values, function(Y) {
    idx <- sync_years == Y
    sqrt(mean((sync_pred[idx] - sync_true[idx])^2))
  })
  C_rmse <- sapply(year_values, function(Y) {
    idx <- C_years == Y
    sqrt(mean((C_pred[idx] - C_true[idx])^2))
  })

  cat("===", method_name, "- scaling with number of years ===\n")
  cat("(mean +/- sd over", ncol(sync_time_mat), "reps per year count)\n\n")
  header <- sprintf("%-6s | %-16s | %-16s | %-9s | %-9s | %-9s",
                     "Years", "Sync time (s)", "C time (s)", "Speedup", "Sync RMSE", "C RMSE")
  cat(header, "\n")
  cat(strrep("-", nchar(header)), "\n")
  for (i in seq_along(year_values)) {
    cat(sprintf("%-6d | %6.2f +/- %5.2f | %6.2f +/- %5.2f | %6.2fx  | %9.4f | %9.4f\n",
                year_values[i],
                sync_time_mean[i], sync_time_sd[i],
                C_time_mean[i], C_time_sd[i],
                speedup_mean[i],
                sync_rmse[i], C_rmse[i]))
  }
  cat("\n")

  invisible(list(sync_time_mean = sync_time_mean, sync_time_sd = sync_time_sd,
                 C_time_mean    = C_time_mean,    C_time_sd    = C_time_sd,
                 speedup_mean   = speedup_mean,   speedup_sd   = speedup_sd,
                 sync_rmse = sync_rmse, C_rmse = C_rmse))
}

# Plots mean elapsed time vs number of years for sync and C, with +/- sd error bars
plot_scaling <- function(method_name, year_values, sync_mean, sync_sd, C_mean, C_sd) {
  col_sync <- "#234ec2"
  col_C    <- "#c20d0d"

  ylim_range <- range(c(sync_mean - sync_sd, sync_mean + sync_sd,
                         C_mean    - C_sd,    C_mean    + C_sd), na.rm = TRUE)
  ylim_range[1] <- max(ylim_range[1], 0)

  plot(year_values, sync_mean, type = "b", col = col_sync, pch = 15,
       ylim = ylim_range,
       xlab = "Number of years", ylab = "Elapsed time (s)",
       main = paste(method_name, ": R-parallel vs C, scaling with years"))
  grid()
  arrows(year_values, sync_mean - sync_sd, year_values, sync_mean + sync_sd,
         angle = 90, code = 3, length = 0.05, col = col_sync)
  lines(year_values, C_mean, type = "b", col = col_C, pch = 17)
  arrows(year_values, C_mean - C_sd, year_values, C_mean + C_sd,
         angle = 90, code = 3, length = 0.05, col = col_C)
  legend("topleft", legend = c("R-parallel (sync)", "C implementation"),
         col = c(col_sync, col_C), pch = c(15, 17), lty = 1)
}
```

## Unpack

```{r unpack, results='hold'}
print_meta("ENCE - R parallel (sync)", ence_sync$meta)
print_meta("ENCE - C implementation",  ence_C$meta)
print_meta("MICE - R parallel (sync)", mice_sync$meta)
print_meta("MICE - C implementation",  mice_C$meta)

# Sanity checks: sync/C pairs must have been generated against the same
# sweep and the same fixed station panel, or the comparison isn't apples-to-apples
stopifnot(identical(ence_sync$meta$year_values, ence_C$meta$year_values))
stopifnot(identical(mice_sync$meta$year_values, mice_C$meta$year_values))
stopifnot(ence_sync$meta$n_stations == ence_C$meta$n_stations)
stopifnot(mice_sync$meta$n_stations == mice_C$meta$n_stations)

ence_year_values <- ence_sync$meta$year_values
mice_year_values <- mice_sync$meta$year_values
```

## Overall Metrics

```{r metrics, results='hold'}
report_metrics(ence_sync$true_y, ence_sync$sync_y, "ENCE - R parallel (sync)", ence_sync$sync_time)
report_metrics(ence_C$true_y,    ence_C$C_y,       "ENCE - C implementation", ence_C$C_time)
report_metrics(mice_sync$true_y, mice_sync$sync_y, "MICE - R parallel (sync)", mice_sync$sync_time)
report_metrics(mice_C$true_y,    mice_C$C_y,       "MICE - C implementation", mice_C$C_time)
```

## ENCE: Timing Table

```{r ence_table, results='hold'}
ence_summary <- print_scaling_table("ENCE", ence_year_values,
                                     ence_sync$sync_time_mat, ence_C$C_time_mat,
                                     ence_sync$true_y, ence_sync$sync_y, ence_sync$sync_years,
                                     ence_C$true_y,    ence_C$C_y,       ence_C$C_years)
```

## ENCE: Scaling Plot

```{r ence_plot, results='hold'}
plot_scaling("ENCE", ence_year_values,
             ence_summary$sync_time_mean, ence_summary$sync_time_sd,
             ence_summary$C_time_mean,    ence_summary$C_time_sd)
```

## MICE: Timing Table

```{r mice_table, results='hold'}
mice_summary <- print_scaling_table("MICE", mice_year_values,
                                     mice_sync$sync_time_mat, mice_C$C_time_mat,
                                     mice_sync$true_y, mice_sync$sync_y, mice_sync$sync_years,
                                     mice_C$true_y,    mice_C$C_y,       mice_C$C_years)
```

## MICE: Scaling Plot

```{r mice_plot, results='hold'}
plot_scaling("MICE", mice_year_values,
             mice_summary$sync_time_mean, mice_summary$sync_time_sd,
             mice_summary$C_time_mean,    mice_summary$C_time_sd)
```
